name: Eye Open
description: Open one great eye of soul above the user and look through it at the near ground.

name: Cerulean Glance
description: Cast a quick pale-blue glance at one soul and read its mood in a heartbeat.

name: Lid Close
description: Drop a lid over the great eye and the mind behind it so that hostile souls see only blank calm.

name: Eye Sharpen
description: Sharpen the great eye until it picks out the smallest tremor of intent in a crowd.

name: Pupil Narrow
description: Narrow the eye to a single bright point to read one soul to its depths.

name: Tear Wash
description: Wash a clinging taint from one ally's soul in a single bright tear of force.

name: Unblinking Eye
description: Keep the great eye open without rest across a whole field and miss no soul in it.

name: Eye Pierce
description: Drive the focus of the eye like a spike through one foe's guard of mind.

name: Heaven Glance
description: Raise the eye to the height of the sky and glance across a whole country in one look.

name: Eye Unlidded
description: The school's closing move that throws the great eye fully open and reads every soul in sight ally and foe alike with a reach that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Skyward Ear
description: Tilt the soul's hearing upward and listen for what is moving above and beyond sight.

name: Lofty Hark
description: Hark from a height to one distant soul and catch its voice of feeling.

name: High Hush
description: Hold a hush high over the mind so that hostile noise cannot settle on it.

name: Soar Lend
description: Lend a lift of hearing to one ally so that the ally's sense soars above the press of the fight.

name: Wing Reach
description: Spread the hearing like wings to take in a broad stretch of ground at once.

name: Height Count
description: Count the souls on every level of a tall place by the layers of their sound.

name: Pure Air
description: Breathe clean thin air through one ally's soul to carry off dread and taint.

name: Zenith Hearing
description: Hear every soul beneath from the highest point of the sensing soul and tell friend from foe by the sound.

name: Plunging Hush
description: Drop a crushing hush from above upon one foe so that the foe's own senses go dead for a moment.

name: Vault Hearing
description: Hear as if from the top of the sky's vault and take in every soul across a wide land.

name: Skyward Choir
description: The school's closing move that joins every ally in reach into one choir of hearing so that all share each other's senses to a depth that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Crown Spark
description: Kindle a spark at the crown of the soul and read what it first touches.

name: Lantern Ring
description: Set a ring of small lanterns round the user and read every soul that crosses it.

name: Glow Cloak
description: Wrap the user in a cloak of soft glow that blinds a hostile soul that stares into it.

name: Lantern Lend
description: Hand one of the lanterns to an ally so that the ally sees as the user sees.

name: Crown Weave
description: Weave the lanterns into a crown that reads a wide ground as one picture.

name: Lamp Wash
description: Pour lamp light over one ally's soul to wash out a dark curse.

name: Hundred Lamps
description: Light a hundred lamps at once over a great ground so that no soul hides in any corner of it.

name: Lamp Burst
description: Burst every lamp in a flash of soul light that dazes every foe in the ring.

name: Crowned Sight
description: Crown the soul with its full light and see every soul in a great domain in perfect detail.

name: Lantern Dominion
description: The school's closing move that lights the full crown so that every weaker soul inside it is read and pressed still with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Sunken Bowl
description: Let the soul sink into a deep still basin and feel the souls that ripple its surface.

name: Rim Feel
description: Feel for the rim of the basin and learn how far the sensing can still be pushed.

name: Floor Search
description: Search for the floor of a basin that has none and learn how much it holds.

name: Spill Guard
description: Hold the basin level so that a hostile touch spills away without wetting the user's mind.

name: Bowl Lend
description: Lend a measure from the basin to one ally so that the ally's soul runs fuller.

name: Flow Chart
description: Chart every stream of feeling that runs into the basin from the ground around.

name: Bowl Rinse
description: Rinse one ally's soul in the basin's clear water until its stains are gone.

name: Feeder Read
description: Trace each feeder stream back to the soul that sends it.

name: Bottomless Read
description: Read a soul with no floor and no rim and take in all of it without strain.

name: Brim Tremor
description: Shake the whole basin so that a wave of soul force rolls over every foe at its edge.

name: Limitless Read
description: Pour the sensing soul into the basin without limit and read every soul within a vast reach.

name: Rimless Bowl
description: The school's closing move that removes the rim so that the sensing soul drinks in every soul that flows near it with a reach that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Swept Ear
description: Let the wind sweep the ear of the soul clear so that distant feeling comes through.

name: Gust Heed
description: Hear one soul over a roaring wind by tuning to the pitch of its feeling.

name: Wind Brace
description: Set the mind against a hard soul wind with a firm stance of will.

name: Vowed Gust
description: Swear one ally to the same wind so that both hear alike across a distance.

name: Gust Tally
description: Count every soul the wind passes over in a single gust.

name: Clean Gust
description: Send a clean hard gust through one ally's soul to blow out stale taint.

name: Carried Voices
description: Gather the voices of feeling that the wind carries from a whole region and sort them by source.

name: Sundering Gale
description: Hurl a sundering gale of soul force that scatters the concentration of every foe it crosses.

name: Tempest Hearing
description: Hear through a raging tempest as through still air and read every soul inside it.

name: Ceaseless Gale
description: The school's closing move that lets a gale of hearing blow without end across the land and read every soul under it with a reach that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Far Warden
description: Post a warden of soul at a distance and let it report what draws near.

name: Threat Scent
description: Catch the sour scent of ill intent on a soul before any weapon is drawn.

name: Warden Ward
description: Guard the post of the warden against any soul that tries to blind it.

name: Early Warning
description: Feel an approaching danger long before it reaches the charge and judge its strength.

name: Relay Sense
description: Pass a warning from warden to warden across a long line so that it arrives at once.

name: Warden Ease
description: Ease the strain of a long watch from one ally and clear the dull haze it leaves.

name: Sentinel Link
description: Link the user to each sentinel so that all share one alert mind.

name: Rim Sweep
description: Sweep the farthest edge of the watched ground and mark every hostile soul upon it.

name: Warning Lance
description: Loose a lance of soul at the leading foe of an approaching force to break its rhythm.

name: Outer Vigil
description: Keep an outer vigil across a vast ground and feel every threat that stirs within it.

name: Threat Unmasked
description: The school's closing move that strips every disguise from the souls in reach and shows what each one intends with a reach that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Retained Bearing
description: Hold a bearing on a chosen soul through any twist of the fight.

name: Pull Bearing
description: Feel the pull of a marked soul and learn at once which way it lies.

name: Constant Bearing
description: Brace the mind so that no soul trick can turn the user from the bearing.

name: Course Share
description: Lend the bearing to one ally so that the ally can follow it unaided.

name: Triple Bearing
description: Take three bearings together and pin a hidden soul to a single spot.

name: Drift Cure
description: Cure the drift of a mind turned about by a soul trick and set it on its true bearing.

name: Lost Found
description: Find a soul that has vanished from every other sense by feeling for the gap it leaves.

name: Bearing Lance
description: Loose a lance along a held bearing to reach a foe who hides behind every sense.

name: Never Lost
description: Make every soul in a wide ground a fixed point that can never again be lost.

name: Bearing Unbroken
description: The school's closing move that ties an unbreakable bearing to every soul in reach so that none can hide or flee unfelt with a hold that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Quiet Under
description: Listen for the quiet that lies beneath every voice and feeling.

name: Voice Strip
description: Strip the noise from one soul's voice and hear only what it truly holds.

name: Hush Oath
description: Swear the mind to silence so that no probing voice can find a hold in it.

name: Held Stillness
description: Hold the user's soul in perfect stillness so that fainter things come into feeling.

name: Silent Reading
description: Read the silent thoughts that lie under a speaker's words.

name: Beneath Mend
description: Mend the deep hurt under an ally's calm face that nothing else has reached.

name: Oath Stillness
description: Share the sworn stillness with one ally so that both stand calm in a storm.

name: Timbre Weigh
description: Weigh every voice in a gathering and find the one that speaks with most force.

name: Under Voices
description: Reach beneath a thousand voices and read the one feeling that lies under them all.

name: Silencing Oath
description: Swear a silence over a crowd of foes so that every raised voice falls and every will goes quiet.

name: Quiet Reveal
description: Open a hollow of quiet across a wide ground so that every soul in it shows plainly against the stillness.

name: Stillness Entire
description: The school's closing move that brings a perfect all-hearing stillness upon the field so that every soul within is read in full with a depth that scales with the user's reserve.
